source_evidence: D326~16:57 on public uphill street near storehouse2, V with successfully acquired original invoice; Cirren/Fenar nearby, Mara at Copper Hart. Exact player 'knack and past life if needed' authorizes both in order as necessary on the SAME pending proficient Sleight of Hand check (initial actual d20 4+8=12/DC15). Actual Knack d6=2 yields14, not sufficient; conditional Past Life d6=4 independently raises original12 to16/DC15 success, combined rolled total18 if both were retained; predeclared expenditure rule retains the sufficient Past Life only, discards unsuccessful/unneeded Knack, so Psi6/6 unchanged, Past Life3→2/3. No new d20 or other resource. V takes the single invoice unobtrusively; merchant has not noticed loss or identified party at this moment, no guaranteed permanent ignorance. New exact invoice contents fixed before presentation in actual scene: 'RIVERSIDE STOREHOUSE No. 2 — Received in full: 36 gp. One case fine imported lace. Lot 27, transferred from Storehouse No. 1. For the joint freight account: paid.' Seller's account mark and buyer's receipt endorsement present, no names yet read/identified, no customs clearance certificate or duty payment on this invoice. The 36gp/lot27 and ordinary joint account description are new DM-adjudicated mundane document details consistent with previously observed sale and fixed two-storehouse trading operation, not previously established historic price or evidence of smuggling by themselves. V has direct custody of original; no copying, forgery, delivery to Watch, return to merchant, money taken, legal authorization or other accusation. Invoice links the observed case and both warehouses to a common freight account; does not prove merchant's knowing participation, seller's personal identity, scale of other trade or connection to murders. Cirren did not assist theft; remains concerned about taking innocent party's record. Fenar stays with Cirren. Await V's next decision. All counters/custody and commitments unchanged except Past Life and invoice.
pending_action: D326~16:57 public uphill street near second of the two fixed privately leased riverside storehouses, Orsaven. V/Cirren/Fenar together in ordinary public foot traffic; Mara accepted V's request to return to Copper Hart, safely returned during ordinary city walk, remains there with coach/four horses, not participating in surveillance. Exact player: 'Mara you should go back to the inn... we will be back soon. Everyone else, lets follow the money quietly'. Authorizes discreet observation and ordinary public shadowing, not boarding, purchase, trespass, magic, seizure, violence or promises. Actual 16:00 selected evening ferry departure and illicit transfer fixed before dice as local DM adjudication consistent with prepared selected-run operation, not a recovered historical schedule; ~16:10 visible transfer at assessment landing. Cirren observed lamp operator from public steps25ft above; V/Fenar observed from public lower landing/fenders, allowing complementary sightlines without invented face recognition. Saw a patched-sail lighter alongside ferry, cases moved across plank, a man awaiting lower steps received cases, and a discreet purse passed from that man to the landing official after the lamp signal; contents/value/purpose not directly established. Passengers departed normally, no intervention, injury, alert, boat hire or cargo seizure. Rejoined and followed receiving merchant/cases on ordinary public towpath to storehouse1, staying unnoticed with actual group Stealth DC14 (V19+11=30, Cirren advantage7/8+2=10, Fenar18+5=23; 2/3 succeeds). Saw cases admitted through storehouse1's south public-towpath-facing loading door; receiver passes coin purse to a man with account book, who writes a document at loading bay. No reading, receipt custody, identities, verified bribe amount, proof of murders or illicit provenance beyond coxswain testimony and actual observations. Party outside on public path, no trespass. DM-only retained fixed setup: storehouse1 60x40ft, two20ft loading bays, rear10ft office, south loading doors/north uphill street exit, 10ft landing; storehouse2 150ft along towpath, upper meeting room 200ft uphill. Existing finite roster/initial allocation remains; only visible workers/keeper and two armed escorts at entrance, not automatically hostile; no meeting/attack/clock or further inference. Source dm-ferry-setup.md @300789a66801d87700502e1499b9cfbb15ff72b4, dm-ferry-ii.md @5b3e57c906b5e7bf90c45c870c42e320aaa01afa. D326 paymaster48gp held, restitution authority notification promised not confirmed, no funds recovered. Party resources unchanged from previous: V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP6/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 shield/boots, no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia; Mara/animals healthy. Purse2049gp8sp6cp rations21/feed28 LR0/6, surveillance not rest, no spending. Other commitments unchanged: royal decision pending, Kestrel confidential copies complete originals retained; frontier commission300+1300 contingent; western conditional service-house grant not deed, Coris300 pending optional800, magic orders balance520 target353, Elara Caereth Severin assent unconfirmed. V dice delegated.  D326~16:55. Exact player 'Follow the package' authorizes continuing the existing quiet cargo observation, not entering private premises or taking goods. V/Cirren/Fenar wait at public towpath; within ~15min a yard hand wheels one of the same observed ferry cases from storehouse1 to fixed storehouse2 150ft farther along public towpath. Newly played ordinary stock-distribution event within existing finite operation, not a prepared secret meeting or forced chain. Existing group Stealth success persists across this contiguous public observation; no new check needed to watch from outside, no active search for party. At open loading bay of storehouse2 the hand opens that case for an independent visiting cloth merchant/customer; party directly sees cream-colored folded fine lace inside, observes customer inspect goods, pay keeper/attending seller and receive an ordinary written invoice. Customer is a new incidental independent purchaser, not an added syndicate member; knowledge of illicit provenance not established, amount, invoice text, full identity and destination unverified. One witnessed case now in customer's handcart, customer preparing to leave uphill street toward ordinary commercial district. Other cases remain in storehouse1 untracked, no new boat or staff deployment, no escalation/violent act. Observable chain is same ferry case → storehouse1 → storehouse2 → sale to local customer; possible lawful corroboration via this customer's invoice and testimony, or further public following; no evidence of connection of current actors to Quenwood's murders established. Party stays outside on public towpath with clear view of loading bay and street approach, no entry, contact, purchase, seizure, resources, roll or further V action. Mara safely at Copper Hart, all party counters/custody/commitments unchanged. Await V decision. D326~16:56 on ordinary public uphill street near storehouse2. Exact player 'V will sneak and try to steal the invoice unnoticed' authorizes V's own attempt to take the cloth customer's folded invoice, not other goods or combat. Merchant accessible in public and not yet alerted. Cirren quietly declines to assist theft from a third party whose knowledge is unproved; no willing meaningful Help from Fenar in this solo unobtrusive task; existing successful tail covers routine approach. Predeclared Dexterity(Sleight of Hand) DC15, modifier+8 (+4 Dex +3 proficiency +1 attuned Luckstone); 15+ unobtrusive acquisition,11–14 abort without acquiring or alerting,<=10 noticed. Genuine d20 face4 total12 fails initial check by3. No invoice taken, no alert or pursuit at this point.
